name: The moment of disclosure
source:
The story is told from the perspective of a ninth-grade girl who has just transferred to a new school. You take care of your strange internet friend, who is apparently hiding the fact that he goes to this very same school... You wonder, why is that?

[Translated from [url=https://t.me/THE_MOMENT_OF_DISCLOSURE/2]Telegram[/url]]
translation:
这个故事是从一个刚刚转学到新学校的九年级女孩的角度来讲述的。你照顾你奇怪的网友，他显然隐瞒了他就读同一所学校的事实……你想知道，这是为什么？

[译自[url=https://t.me/THE_MOMENT_OF_DISCLOSURE/2]Telegram[/url]]
